component.name: Reasonix
component.summary: Open-source AI coding agent you can leave running
开源 AI 编程代理，可持续运行

description.p: Reasonix is an open-source AI coding agent you can leave running. One local engine, four ways in — terminal, desktop app, browser, or your editor over ACP. Plan mode, permissions, a workspace sandbox and checkpoints keep long autonomous runs reviewable. A single Go binary, no runtime to install.

ul.li: Multi-model agent engine with interactive, print, and run modes
Desktop shell, terminal CLI, HTTP+SSE serve, and ACP/editor integrations
Plan mode with tool-approval permissions and workspace sandbox
Checkpoints, session recovery, and reviewable long-running tasks
MCP server management, sub-agents, extensions, and hooks
Built-in upgrade mechanism and shell completion

description.p: Reasonix 是一款开源 AI 编程代理，可以长时间持续运行。一个本地引擎，四种接入方式——终端、桌面应用、浏览器或通过 ACP 接入编辑器。计划模式、权限控制、工作区沙箱和检查点让长时间自主运行保持可审查。单个 Go 二进制，无需安装运行时。

ul.li: 多模型代理引擎，支持交互式、打印和 run 模式
桌面壳、终端 CLI、HTTP+SSE 服务和 ACP/编辑器集成
计划模式，带工具审批权限和工作区沙箱
检查点、会话恢复和可审查的长时间任务
MCP 服务器管理、子代理、扩展和钩子
内置升级机制和 shell 补全
